purpose: Claude Code friendly source-of-truth data for Penn Men’s Golf member book / alumni web app.

sourceSummary.letterWinnerSourceDescription: Penn Men’s Golf All-Time Letter Winners PDF uploaded by user.
sourceSummary.rosterSourceDescription: Existing 2000-2026 roster master and Penn roster archive fields from prior merged dataset.
sourceSummary.coverageNote: All parsed all-time letter-winner entries are included. Some historical roster seasons are inferred from letter-winning years and flagged in review.needsRosterCheck.

importRulesForClaudeCode: Use the members array as the source of truth.
Do not use the XLSX file for code import.
Do not re-parse the PDF unless the source PDF changes.
Do not filter out entries where review.needsRosterCheck is true; that only means roster seasons are unverified, not that the person should be removed.
Do not use legacy publish_to_clubhouse flags from older files; use includeInMemberBook instead.
Letter-winner years are ending years: 2004 means season 2003-04.
Use role === "manager" only to label or optionally hide managers in UI; managers are intentionally included in the dataset.
Use id as the stable key. Do not regenerate IDs from names in app code.
